missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Тюрьма' is nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Старая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'за городом' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Тюрьму' takes the accusative after 'в' to express movement into the prison. 'Его' is the animate accusative object of 'отправили'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Тюрьмы' is genitive after 'из' to express coming out of the prison. 'Вчера' fixes the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Тюрьме' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of the article. 'Статью' is the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Брат сидит в тюрьме два года.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Тюрьме' takes the prepositional after 'в' for static location. 'Два года' expresses the duration of the sentence.
Strategic focus: Instrumental location. 'Тюрьмой' is instrumental after 'за' to mean behind the prison. 'Заключённые' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Тюрьму' is the accusative direct object of 'построил'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'город' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantifier. 'Тюрем' is the genitive plural after 'много', showing the fleeting vowel inserted between consonants. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.

missions.phrase: Эта тюрьма очень старая и страшная.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Тюрьма' is nominative as the subject. 'Старая' and 'страшная' are feminine predicate adjectives joined by 'и'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Тюрьме' takes the dative after 'к' to mean approaching the prison. 'Адвокат' is the subject, and 'рано' adds the time.
